title: Chapter 1265
text:
Who gave you the courage to suddenly appear and compete with me for the position of president?

Han Xiao looked at Rawls' confident appearance, and many guesses flashed through his mind. Watermark Advertisement Test

Watermark Advertisement Test

However, when he thought of the other party's class, the surprise in his heart disappeared.

Oh, so he's a Pugilist. That's fine.

Han Xiao shook his head and stopped guessing Rawls' motives.

Pugilists had a more unique way of thinking. Most of the time, you would think that they were on the first or second level, but in reality, they were on the first level. There was no need to analyze so much.

Han Xiao had considered the possibility of a peak Beyond Grade A participating, but he did not expect it to be a newcomer, forcing him to participate in the voting. However, it was not a big deal. A mere newcomer was not qualified to mess things up.

Although he did not know where the other party's confidence came from, it was understandable since he was a Pugilist …

"Is there anyone else who wants to participate?" Han Xiao looked away and scanned the crowd.

Everyone looked at each other, but no one answered.

Seeing this, Han Xiao nodded. "In that case, only Rawls and I will participate. You can vote now."

Everyone present was a Beyond Grade A Super, so no one's opinion could be ignored. Thus, everyone could express their opinions without any formality.

The members who usually stood on Black Star's side immediately expressed their support for Han Xiao becoming the president. The direct members of the three Universal Civilizations also voted for it. Some of the peak Beyond Grade As who were part of the upper echelons of the association also expressed their support.

All of a sudden, other than Heber, Sisko, Manison, and a few others who gave up, almost all the members of the association supported Han Xiao to become the president. There were many supporters, and the momentum was huge.

On the other hand, Rawls stood alone and did not receive a single vote. He gave off an inexplicable feeling of desolation.

Han Xiao could not help but glance at him with a strange expression.

No, just this?

You did not manage to win over a single person, and you still dare to participate …

What are you showing off?

Just looking at Rawls' uncertain expression, Han Xiao could not help but feel embarrassed for him.

'What are you doing, little brother? Do you really think that people will vote for a newcomer? Do you like to embarrass yourself so much …'

The votes were overwhelming. Han Xiao calmed himself down, cleared his throat, and said, "I'm not sure what to do.

"Then the situation is obvious. Rawls, do you accept this result?"

Everyone looked at Rawls in unison. Their eyes contained ridicule, pity, disdain, and a series of complicated emotions.

Rawls opened his mouth, sat down, and said in a muffled voice, "I accept."

Even though he was betting on the fact that there was no risk involved and that he wouldn't lose anything even if he didn't get chosen, he still felt a little embarrassed when he saw the huge gap between them.

Rawls had a good plan. He knew that there was a high chance that he would not become the president. However, if he could get some votes during the election, he would at least have some say in it. In the future, he would not have to be a newbie anymore. He would be able to participate more deeply in the affairs of the association.

In his opinion, this was the first step for a newcomer.

In order to achieve this goal, it wasn't that he didn't contact the other association members in private and expressed his intention to run for president. Some people had promised to support him, so he had the confidence to run for president.

However, when it came to this, all these b * stards didn't show up!

In fact, what he did not know was that most people thought that he was joking and just casually said it, but it gave Rawls the illusion that he could do it.

Because they were all big shots, Rawls did not dare to flare up. He could only sulk and curse in his heart that verbal promises were indeed unreliable.

Han Xiao was not interested in Rawls' thoughts.

He knew Pugilists too well. It was not that their brains were really made of muscles, but the Pugilist Heart itself was to welcome men and overcome the obstacles of men. It was a challenging mentality that could not be backed down. Those who could become Beyond Grade A would definitely have this personality. In other words, Pugilists who were not headstrong would find it very difficult to become Beyond Grade A.

And this was the reason why Han Xiao had high hopes for Lothaire. After all, this guy was quite headstrong.

Various thoughts flashed through his mind. Han Xiao calmed himself down, looked around, and smiled.

"Thank you for thinking so highly of me. I won't reject the position of president."

Aurora was the first to clap, her face full of excitement.

Seeing that someone was taking the lead, the others hesitated for a moment before clapping their hands symbolically. Most of them were more reserved and were not used to this kind of action.

For a time, there was a round of applause. Han Xiao smiled and returned the greeting.

Although he had guessed that this would be the result, when he succeeded, he was still very happy.

From now on, he was the leader of the Beyond Grade A Association. He could officially lead the Beyond Grade A group, and his influence would rise to a higher level.

The effect of (Proof of Leadership) was also updated in real time. When he was the vice president, he could only obtain a portion of the bonus. Now that he was the president, the bonus effect was finally complete. Although it was not a qualitative change, it was still the icing on the cake.

After the president was chosen, the vice president position was empty. An election was also held. This time, the system was changed from one vice president to two, which were respectively Kasuyi and Sierron.

Other than that, the association also decided on a few new directors. Hella was chosen and sat on the director seat of the association.

The voting process was very simple. After the process was completed smoothly, the transition was smooth, and the handover was completed.

Han Xiao finally sat on the main seat, with Kasuyi and Sierron on his left and right.

Inauguration speeches were not an exception even in the Beyond Grade A circle. Seeing that everyone was looking at him, Han Xiao pondered for a few seconds before slowly speaking.

"Since I've been elected as the new president, I'll say a few simple words … It has been fifty years since the Beyond Grade A Association was founded. We've built a foundation from nothing. So far, we've done quite well, and this includes the contributions of the former president, Manison, and everyone present.

The original intention of the association was to unite all the Beyond Grade As, become a group of interests, and protect the entire class. This purpose will be maintained, and no decision made in the future can deviate from this principle. All individuals or organizations that want to split the Beyond Grade A group are enemies of the association.

As for me … I'll do my best to make the association develop better and build it into a safe haven for all the Beyond Grade As. There's no need to say more. Everyone knows my character. I'll definitely do my best to meet everyone's expectations. "

At this moment, no matter what their impression of Han Xiao was, every Beyond Grade A was nodding in approval.

Everyone present knew that from this moment onward, the Beyond Grade A Association had officially entered the era of Black Star!

Looking at the faces with different expressions, Han Xiao paused for a moment before speaking again with an inexplicable tone.

"Maybe not long from now, we'll welcome a revolution. Everyone, be mentally prepared."

Hearing this, many people felt that Han Xiao's words had a deeper meaning, but they did not understand what it meant.

Han Xiao did not explain.

When the members of the Holy Covenant appeared, the upheaval would come.

He could already vaguely see that the storm of the era was about to rise again!

…

In the Primeval Star River, in a secret base of the Mecha Empire …

After the election meeting ended, Manison deactivated the remote projection, and his gaze returned to the dark room.

He picked up another communicator, which was still in communication mode. The other party was Kasuyi.

"Thanks to you taking the initiative to withdraw, the election went very smoothly," Kasuyi said with a smile.

"Let me make it clear. I didn't give up on the election because you came to beg me."

Manison was expressionless, and his tone was indifferent.

Outsiders did not know that the two of them had negotiated in private. Kasuyi had secretly come to find Manison and asked him to give up on the idea of re-election. They had secretly reached an agreement.

Kasuyi smiled. "No matter what, you've helped me."

"Humph, it was a good election, but you made it seem like Black Star had the final say." Manison snorted coldly, his tone filled with dissatisfaction.

"That's called everyone's wish." Kasuyi laughed.

"I really don't know what benefits Black Star gave you to help him like this. If I were to participate, even if I might not be re-elected, I would at least be the vice president." Manison frowned.

Kasuyi shook his head. "He didn't give me any benefits. I did it willingly."

"Ever since you went to the secondary dimension with him a few decades ago, you have always been on his side. Could it be that Black Star used his charisma to convince you? Humph, anyway, it's none of my business. Just don't forget that you owe me a favor. "

Manison snorted softly.

"I'll remember, old friend."

Kasuyi smiled, and his figure disappeared from the screen.

Manison hung up the communication, and his eyes narrowed slightly.

Kasuyi's request was a very small factor in him giving up on causing trouble in the election. He had just done him a favor. In fact, Manison had long planned to do this.

The first reason was that he knew his own limits. He knew that it was impossible for him to win against Black Star, so he did not want to embarrass himself. The second was to lay low and let Black Star stand at the center of the storm while he kept a low profile, secretly looking for an opportunity to make a comeback in the future election.

The third reason was the main reason Manison made such a decision. After forty years of fermenting, the Beyond Grade A Association had become more and more independent, causing the three Universal Civilizations to not receive any new allies. He saw the brewing crisis and believed that the three Universal Civilizations would soon take further action.

Retreating now was to avoid the pressure and let Black Star take the blame.

On the other hand, Manison also understood that Black Star was the best candidate to lead the association at this time. If he spoke to the three Universal Civilizations, he would be able to relieve the pressure on the three Universal Civilizations to a certain extent. There was a greater possibility that he would lead the association through this crisis and prevent the 'great purge'.

He had a personal grudge with Black Star, but protecting the safety of the Beyond Grade A group was more important to him. For this reason, he chose to step aside and not cause trouble for Han Xiao's succession.

Manison lowered his eyes.

"The three Universal Civilizations won't sit by and watch us grow endlessly. After more than forty years of cultivation, it's time for them to make a move … Black Star, I wonder if your method can handle the new 'Tragedy of the Pinnacles'?

Your philosophy is wrong. Peaceful development can't be exchanged for compromise. If we don't make overlords like the three Universal Civilizations feel afraid, how can they allow us to grow freely? If you can't handle it, don't blame me for releasing the imitation Intelligent Mutiny Virus … "

…

The news of Black Star replacing the Mecha Empire as the president of the Beyond Grade A Association spread like wildfire, quickly spreading throughout the galactic society that had been paying attention to this matter.

A large number of reports appeared on the internet, announcing the arrival of 'Black Star's era'!

All of a sudden, Black Star, who had kept a low profile for forty years, once again stood on the cusp of public opinion. His fame and reputation soared, and his legendary deeds were once again dug up by various media outlets, attracting a lot of attention. Even the Germinal Financial Group's stock price rose a lot because of this.

Overall, the galactic society had a good attitude toward this change. Black Star was the universal hero who solved the Intelligent Plague, the winner of the Stewart Peace Prize, the winner of the Galaxy Medal, the co-consultant of the three Universal Civilizations … This series of reputations was much better than the Mecha Empire's. Most people believed that the Beyond Grade A Association would develop harmoniously under the leadership of Han Xiao.

While the outside world expressed all kinds of opinions about the change of the Beyond Grade A Association, Han Xiao had already secretly used the King to teleport to the Ancient Star Desert and found the Holy Covenant organization.

Not only did he go there to discuss the Primordial Ones coming out of seclusion, but he also went there for another important matter …

The keys to open the Third Sanctum were gathered once again!
